title: SpaceX turns to Apollo for $40 billion in AI chip financing
teaser: SpaceX is arranging $40 billion in financing for AI chips and related server equipment through Apollo Global Management. An Apollo-managed vehicle will buy the hardware and lease it to SpaceX for roughly five to five-and-a-quarter years per batch, with each term starting when that batch is delivered. The deal is expected to close by year-end, subject to conditions, and leases are due to begin in the first half of 2027. The structure gives SpaceX another way to fund a rapid buildout without relying only on conventional debt markets.
